about: B shots for the v5 film (live phone-call charts, final transcript, finale, end card). Each page reads its numbers from shots/numbers_b.js (generated by shots/export_b.py from runs/*.json; export_b.py also checks every narration caption number against the numbers on screen) and supplies its own fine print with the sources. Palette from the builder's CSS variables (--bg, --ink, --muted, --ours, --pipecat, --livekit, --red), flat: no gradients, glow, shadows or icons. On screen: one number per system, no ranges, CIs or jargon (fine print only); bars grow from 0.4 to 1.2 s and each value appears at its final value when its bar lands. Results = finale.html only (reference study, REFERENCE_DEMOS.md shot 11): the headline numbers one at a time, cut-ins, first words, unanswered turns ((dur - 2)/3 s each) and the optional transcript card (2 s; params.wer = false drops it and the three cards share dur). Fine print: one short line per card, source names only; full provenance in shots/numbers_b.json. Out of the cut: chart_live, chart_wer, chart_icsi, chart_turnbench, scorecard (files kept until the builder drops them from shots_def.py), and earlier the AMI, VAD, calls and synthetic rooms pages.
